amenitiesDescription:
Pools & deck: Four pools (86-foot sunset, hot and cold plunges, salt rejuvenation, lap with spa garden) with resort-style pool-deck F&B.

Nobu F&B & longevity: Ground-floor Nobu with bayfront access and owners' private dining, residents-only restaurant on 11, bayfront café and bar, and in-residence dining with private chef service. The $25M Longevity Center covers cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen, IV peptides, ozone therapy, and dedicated recovery suites, paired with a Nobu Spa (hammam, sauna, treatment rooms).

Movement & services: Fitness, yoga, Pilates, spinning, outdoor pavilion, padel courts, and sports simulators. Private porte-cochère arrival with valet, self-park, and private garage options; butler, house car, lifestyle manager, and 24-hour concierge.
description: Miami's first Nobu-branded residences. 75-story Foster + Partners tower on Biscayne Bay, 306 homes from $2.2M, with a $25M longevity program and residents-only Nobu dining.

faq.question: What are 619 Brickell prices and floor plans?
faq.answer: Nine residence types across 306 homes, from about $2.23M (1 bedroom) through $16.5M Sky Villas; penthouses on request. Homes run 1–5 bedrooms and roughly 1,160–5,526 SF. A 4,826 SF Sky Villa (Unit 28D) sold for $20.5M in June 2026 ($4,247/SF). See current floor plans for live availability.

faq.question: What is the deposit structure?
faq.answer: 40% across pre-construction (10% at contract, 5% at 90 days, 15% at groundbreaking, 10% at top-off). 60% balance at closing.

faq.question: When is estimated completion?
faq.answer: Estimated completion is 2030 per the developer.

faq.question: How is this different from the existing Nobu Hotel + Residences in Miami?
faq.answer: Separate product. 619 Brickell is Nobu Hospitality's first branded residential tower in Miami: Foster + Partners, pre-construction on Biscayne Bay, with a $25M longevity program and residents-only Nobu dining. It is not the earlier delivered Nobu hotel residence inventory.

faq.question: Are residences furnished/turnkey at delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. All 306 residences deliver fully furnished and turnkey with Nobu Hospitality.

faq.question: Who is the developer and architect?
faq.answer: Developed by 13th Floor Investments + Key International. Foster + Partners is design architect; Sieger Suarez is architect of record. Interiors by Design Agency · Studio Munge.

investmentThesis: Miami's first Nobu-branded residences, and the first in the city built around longevity and biohacking rather than spa-as-amenity, with a $25 million medical-grade wellness program. Foster + Partners (Apple Park, Hearst Tower) is design architect on its first Miami tower of this scale. Nobu Hospitality programs F&B end to end: residents-only restaurant on 11, ground-floor Nobu with owners' private dining, and in-residence dining. A June 2026 Sky Villa sale at $20.5M ($4,247/SF) confirmed top-stack demand after the April launch. Residences from $2.2M; penthouses on request. Delivery estimated 2030.

name: 619 Brickell (Nobu Residences)
residenceContent: Foster + Partners shaped this 75-story Brickell bayfront tower as five twisting cassettes, rotating each tier so residences open to Biscayne Bay. The site sits on one of the corridor's last walkable direct-bay parcels. Inside, one- to five-bedroom plans, Sky Villas, and penthouses deliver turnkey: floor-to-ceiling glazing, wraparound terraces, custom kitchens with integrated appliances, and spa-inspired bathrooms in stone and warm wood, furnished and styled with Nobu Hospitality.
